task.description: Design the schema-per-tenant provisioning mechanism for REQ-022 on branch feature/WF02-REQ022-20260816. Write lib/letflow/design/<module>.md per WF-02 Step 1's procedure: public function signatures with @spec-style types, key data structures, invariants, DB tables/columns/indexes, cross-module deps, and open questions left unresolved (do not silently guess).
acceptance_criteria: priv/repo/migrations gains a tenant_schemas migration (public/default schema) that applies cleanly via mix ecto.migrate, with columns for at minimum tenant_id and schema_name
a provision_tenant_schema/1-equivalent function exists that issues a real CREATE SCHEMA and records the mapping in tenant_schemas, demonstrated against at least one non-default tenant schema name

a migration-replay function exists that re-applies priv/repo/migrations/ against a specific tenant schema via Ecto's prefix: option, demonstrated by confirming at least one table exists under the provisioned schema's own information_schema, not just under public

the moduledoc/description explicitly states, as an open question rather than a silent decision, whether REQ-015's users/groups/tenant_role migrations are retrofitted to use :prefix now or remain in public schema

result.summary: Designed Letflow.TenantProvisioning (lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning.ex) and its Ecto schema Letflow.TenantProvisioning.Registration (lib/letflow/tenant_provisioning/registration.ex), plus a new tenant_schemas migration (public/default schema, FK to tenants.id, unique indexes on tenant_id and schema_name, timestamps(inserted_at: :provisioned_at)). Specified provision_tenant_schema/1 (idempotent CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS + registry insert, pg_advisory_xact_lock-serialized, atomic via one Repo.transaction, reuses the insert/on_conflict/re-select idiom already established in lib/letflow/identity.ex) and replay_migrations/2 (wraps Ecto.Migrator.run/4 with :prefix, converts its raise-on-failure behavior into {:ok,_}|{:error,_}). Central design decision, verified directly against deps/ecto_sql source rather than assumed: a literal whole-directory migration replay cannot work against this project's actual priv/repo/migrations/ contents (global S1/REQ-022 migrations would re-run against the tenant prefix and collide, and a naive tenant-scoped migration without a prefix()-truthiness guard would leak an empty table into public on every plain mix ecto.migrate) -- so the design specifies (a) an explicit tenant_scoped_migrations/0 registry function (starts at [], REQ-023+ append to it) as the 'designated per-tenant subset' REQ-022's own acceptance criterion anticipates, and (b) a mandatory if-prefix()-then-create-else-noop guard pattern every tenant-scoped migration (REQ-023 onward) must follow, documented prominently since it's load-bearing for ~20 downstream requirements. Stated REQ-022's own flagged open question (users/groups/tenant_role retrofit) explicitly, unresolved, plus one secondary open question this design surfaced (tenant status check before provisioning). Full acceptance-criteria traceability table included. No implementation code -- signatures/type shapes and a migration column table only.
